property_summary: Ownership transfer authority is fixed: only the original admin (deployer) can ever change owner, so after the admin sets owner to X, any call from X (the new owner, who is not the admin) must revert and leave owner == X; the mutant lets the new owner take over, changing owner.
change_summary: Replace the require check `msg.sender == admin` with `msg.sender == owner` so only the owner (not the admin) can call setOwner.
